scope: Fixed rea-agents 6.8.0 shipped Python, generated Python and direct Python call boundaries. This project's qualification/test scripts are excluded. This is a source inventory, not runtime equivalence qualification.

definitions.covered: The helper's behavior and original integration are implemented in Rust and qualified with identities, failures, limits, cancellation and recovery.
definitions.partial: A concrete production Rust entry implements a demonstrable behavior subset; remaining behavior and incompatible original contract are enumerated. It is not replacement qualification.
definitions.missing: No corresponding production Rust helper/adapter. Generic subprocess ownership, declarations and unrelated fixtures are not counted as a port.

helpers.purpose: Runs inside LLDB embedded Python. Launches one owned process, observes selected native/Objective-C call entries from registers and memory, journals bounded events and output, proves target/module identity, then stops its owned process.

callers.entry: LldbCallTracer.#run; lldb --batch --no-lldbinit; command script import <bridge>; rea_trace <config>

helpers.gap: No Rust observe_native_calls/LLDB bridge. The separate GDB breakpoint fixture and generic process control do not implement LLDB events, identities, budgets, cancellation, or readback.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Cutter Python plugin. Publishes a private descriptor and authenticated loopback protocol, dispatches status/command requests on the application thread, frames bounded replies and reports command completion/unknown outcomes.
helpers.gap: No Rust Cutter plugin/client or real Cutter lifecycle qualification. An Evidence source enum containing an engine name is not an adapter.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Authenticated session bridge on Hopper's dedicated Python thread. Reads documents, bytes, addresses, segments, procedures, names, strings, instructions, pseudocode, references and searches; supports navigation, renaming, comments, bookmarks and shutdown.
helpers.gap: No Rust Hopper session bridge or complete operation mapping. Fixed Ghidra/JADX profiles are different engines and do not replace these Hopper operations.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Offline native mitmproxy tnetstring decoder under caller-supplied mitmdump 12.2.3. Retains and projects records with bounds, validation and redaction. Starts no proxy listener or target requests.
helpers.gap: Rust owned Chrome/CDP capture produces its own bounded fixture observations/HAR. It does not decode native tnetstring files or implement this original inspect_web_network_capture adapter.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Shared request/reply boundary for layout, recorded-core and debugger-launch profiles. Lowers inherited address-space/CPU/file-size limits, establishes private cache, reports typed resource/decoder failures and caps complete JSON replies at 64 MiB.
helpers.gap: General Rust worker budgets and durable ownership are not a compatible port of this decoder reply/resource-failure protocol; no corresponding three decoder profiles are wired.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Offline ELF EXEC/DYN/REL layout via pinned pwntools 4.15.0, pyelftools 0.33 and Unicorn 2.1.2. Preserves section/segment/symbol/relocation source ranges, RELR encoded data, dependency/interpreter names, derived GOT/PLT and qualified mitigation indicators.
helpers.gap: Only bounded ELF headers, sections, program headers and declared symbols overlap. Native preview uses hepta.rea.elf-structure.v1 and partial coverage; it omits relocation/RELR, symbol versions, dependencies, GOT/PLT and mitigation semantics, and does not expose the original inspect_binary_layout Evidence contract. No full helper differential is claimed.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.purpose: Offline Linux little-endian x86_64/aarch64 ELF core decoding. Preserves segment/note ranges and bytes, interprets exact CORE NT_PRSTATUS register/thread data and selected NT_SIGINFO fields, and keeps current live identity and unavailable semantics unknown.
helpers.gap: Rust ELF notes inspect raw note structures/GNU note meanings under a different public operation. There is no recorded-core architecture/ABI/register/signal adapter, pairing contract, or original inspect_recorded_crash output.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

helpers.gap: The native ELF preview is a separate bounded API and does not implement this entrypoint, failure marker classification, decoder ownership or original layout output boundary.
helpers.validation: Read-only package/source inspection; no whole-helper equivalence qualification.

dist/gdb/GdbSessionManager.js Python mentions in forbidden-command prefix checks.

remaining_root_python.conclusion: Native REA routes and engine ownership improvements do not establish that the whole deployed runtime is Python-free.

method.package_files: Enumerated all physical *.py files under the fixed package and parsed Python AST read-only for entrypoints; 13 files.
method.callers: Inspected canonical dist module calls and generated Python recipes; retained bundled callsite hashes without counting copies twice.
method.rust: Read concrete production entrypoints and their wiring, plus targeted source searches. Root was clean at the recorded snapshot.
method.generator_hash_rule: For G01/G03 definition_sha256 is UTF-8 source from the displayed export const declaration through its final semicolon, excluding the immediately following newline/comment/declaration. G02 materialized SHA is the exact 673-byte UTF-8 query; no interpolation/escaping is present.
method.negative_claim_scope: No whole-helper replacement is claimed. Absence refers to this root source snapshot, not to a global engine-installation search.
